company.name: Sable
company.shortDescription: The premium credit and banking platform for US residents with limited credit history
company.description:
Thin file U.S. residents suffer from an uncertain, fragmented, and inefficient path to quality credit and banking options
Sable provides
-Access to credit building cards, a no fee bank account, and debit card within 5 minutes with no credit history, SSN, or U.S address required
-Premium card and brand
-Quickest way to build credit with enhanced multi-point reporting on more data points than any other card
-Faster path to unsecured credit by addressing the full path end to end, with gamified graduation to our own Sable unsecured credit credit card 
-Transparent formula via tangible Sable milestones, guiding our customers along a path to credit building and graduation to unsecured credit

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,000,000, or 26.09% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,621,899 to $33,423,433, a 9.23x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (+4 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (+31).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
